scientific_decisions.decision: Segmentation followed by padded localized blocks and at most ten crops
Preserve native128 external contours, bbox-area150 filter and padded bbox-area top10 sorting, qualified official PARSeq AR/refine1

Fixed six native padding values; complete TEST300 exploration after frozen validation125 checkpoint selection; primary maximum one-to-one unpadded boxIoU>=.5 casefold exact with care denominator and all predictions counted; secondary padded-box scoring separate
Measure actual native foreground count,8-connected per-component areas, per-image coverage and pooled retained box dimensions; mask independent of crop padding
Single RTX3090 CUDA FP32; sequential segmentation batch1 then PARSeq batch32; deterministic,noTF32,noAMP,no crop or mask export. CPU versus CUDA parity is not claimed
Exact paper PARSeq-S/model identities and official recognition metric; post-hoc TEST padding cannot establish independent tuning or universal Word-F1 predictiveness
